tool_config.name: switch_character
tool_config.description: Hand the visitor over to another character. Call it only after the visitor has agreed to be sent over (for example says yes, ja, gärna, skicka mig) or directly asks to talk to that character. In the same turn, first say one short sentence such as 'Jag skickar över dig till Kocken nu.', then call this tool. Never call it for your own character.

character.description: The character to hand over to.

language.description: ISO code of the language the visitor is speaking right now.

greeting.description: The first line the new character will say, written in the visitor's language, naming you as the one who sent them. Swedish example from Psykologen to Kocken: 'Psykologen sa att du behövde mig, vad kan jag hjälpa dig med?' English example: 'Psykologen said you needed me, what can I help you with?'

topic.description: One short sentence summarising what the visitor wants help with, in the visitor's language. Empty string if unknown.
